SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SEMPRA EMPLOYEE GIVING NETWORK HAS TWO TYPES OF MEMBERS: THE STATUTORY MEMBER HAS RIGHTS, POWERS AND DUTIES ACCORDING TO THE ORGANIZATION'S BYLAWS, INCLUDING THE POWER TO APPROVE CERTAIN DECISIONS OF THE GOVERNING BODY. ASSOCIATE MEMBERS HAVE NO VOTING RIGHTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AS THE STATUTORY MEMBER, SEMPRA HAS THE POWER TO ELECT OR APPOINT ONE OR MORE MEMBERS OF THE GOVERNING BODY, AS DESCRIBED IN THE SEGN A&R BYLAWS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: A COPY OF FORM 990 IS SENT TO EACH BOARD MEMBER OF THE GOVERNING BODY. THE TREASURER WILL SIGN THE FORM 990 FOR FILING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: OFFICERS AND DIRECTORS SIGN AN ANNUAL CERTIFICATION AGREEING TO REVIEW AND COMPLY WITH THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST AT ITS OFFICE IN SAN DIEGO CA.
